resolution: Materialized the entire visible model library into real on-disk packages. New materializeSnapshotPackage writer in modelPackageStore.ts lays down mesh/base.blob (cooked content-addressed blob or studio baked verts), the copied .glb/.obj for file-backed models with the manifest viewerPath repointed inside the package, mesh/editmesh.json carrying the authored studio parts, and atlases/base.png from cooked texture blobs — manifest written last as the commit point. hmscAssetCatalog runs it idempotently on every catalog load for any roster model without a package. Verified live: the running dev host hot-reloaded and wrote ~100 packages (props 17→89 dirs, build 1→30), zero empty mesh dirs, all file-backed manifests point inside their package. Committed 72MB library + code.
